scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Long time no see!
Hey, you didn't quit
your business, did you?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
好久不見！
嘿，你該不會不做生意了吧？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Whoa...
You've actually been to Valhalla?! Wow, you've come a long way...
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
哇...
你竟然去過瓦爾哈拉？！
真是經歷了不少事啊...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
It seems that you're not ready to become a Merchant again. Go finish learning the Basic Novice Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
嗯...
看來你還沒準備好重新成為商人。
先去把初心者基礎技能學完吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't worry, we'll always have a Merchant position open for you. Just come back when you're ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
別擔心，我們始終為你留著商人的位置。
準備好了就回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess it's destiny that we meet like this once more. Alright. Once again, let me change you into a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
看來，我們能這樣再次相遇，也是命運的安排。
好，再讓我為你轉職成商人吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah~ How nostalgic. Just like old times! Alright, do your best!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
啊~真讓人懷念，就像回到了從前！
好了，好好努力吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I'm so bored...
When will I hear from my lovely Blossom?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
好無聊啊...
什麼時候才能收到我可愛的布洛森的訊息呢？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there!
How do you like
being a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
你好！
當商人感覺如何？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Having a way with
money certainly
has its perks,
does it not?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
善於賺錢，確實有不少好處，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
We Merchants hate people who are two faced. It's bad for business.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我們商人討厭兩面三刀的人。
這樣的人可做不好生意。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
People who always try to take advantage of other people by selling things at a ridiculous price just so they can make money that they'll waste are the worst.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
有些人賣東西漫天要價，總想著佔別人便宜，賺來的錢卻又隨意揮霍。
這種人最糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Well, in any case, we only accept Novices for job changes to the Merchant class. But I appreciate your interest in what we do.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
總之，我們只接受初心者申請轉職為商人。
不過，還是謝謝你對我們這一行感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there,
{0}.
Unfortunately, you failed to earn your Merchant License this time.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
你好，{0}。
很遺憾，你這次沒能取得商人執照。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I'll erase your records, so come back anytime when you want to reapply.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我會清除你的申請記錄。
想重新申請時，隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there,
{0}.
I'm pleased to tell you
that I have good news!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
你好，{0}。
很高興告訴你，我有個好訊息！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The Merchant Guild accepted your application. You've proven that you are fully qualified to become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
商人公會接受了你的申請。
你已經證明了自己完全有資格成為一名商人。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The only thing to take care of is your Membership Fee.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
現在只剩會費需要處理了。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Pay the rest of the 500 Zeny
scripts.translation: 支付剩餘的500 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
I suppose you currently don't have enough zeny to pay the rest of your Membership fee right now.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
嗯...
看來，你現在的Zeny還不夠繳清剩餘的會費。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah yes...!
Now your
membership
is paid in full.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
啊，好了...！
你的會費已經全部繳清。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Please return when you have earned the 500 zeny that you need to become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
請在你賺到成為商人所需的500 Zeny後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I suppose you need some time to gather some zeny to pay your membership fee. Please come
back as soon as you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
看來，你還需要些時間籌集會費。
準備好後就儘快回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
恭喜！

scripts.text: I'm very pleased that you are joining the Merchant Guild and hope that you will play an active part in Rune-Midgarts' economy.
scripts.translation: 很高興你加入商人公會，希望你能為盧恩·米德加茲的經濟發展積極出力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
*Ahem* Aaaaand let me give you a little bit of money for delivering that message to Blossom for me.
I hope you'll help me again next time~
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
*咳*還有啊，你替我把訊息送給布洛森，這點錢就當是報酬。
希望下次你還願意幫我~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The message you were supposed to deliver as per my request? You've forgotten about that? Oh well. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我托你帶的訊息呢？
你忘了？
好吧，算了。
幹得不錯！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Our goal is to control 20 % of the world's income! We're going to need young, eager people like you!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我們的目標是掌握全世界20%的收入！
我們需要你這樣年輕又有幹勁的人！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But overall, we'll also be happy just to make loads of money.
But we all know that~
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
不過，說到底，能賺大錢，我們就很開心了。
這一點大家都懂~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再送到普隆德拉的劍士協會舊址。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to the Mage Guild in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再送到吉芬的魔法師公會。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再送到夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the package from the storehouse, and then give it to the Kafra Employee stationed on Byalan Island. Her name is Blossom.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取箱子，再交給駐守拜蘭島的卡普拉職員。
她叫布洛森。

scripts.text: [Chief Mahnsoo]
scripts.translation: [首領 曼蘇]

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Kafra Employee stationed near there. Her name is Blossom. Did you get all that?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
到了那裡，把箱子交給附近的卡普拉職員。
她叫布洛森。
都記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the Serial Number of the package is ^3355FF2485741^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the Serial Number of the package is ^3355FF2328137^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge. Remember, the packages Serial Number is ^3355FF2989396^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
到了那裡，把箱子交給負責此事的魔法師公會成員。
記住，箱子的序列號是^3355FF2989396^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge. Remember, the packages Serial Number is ^3355FF2191737^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
到了那裡，把箱子交給負責此事的魔法師公會成員。
記住，箱子的序列號是^3355FF2191737^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
You'll have to find Java Dullihan, the Dyemaker, so that you can deliver the product he ordered.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
你需要找到染料師爪哇·杜利漢，把他訂購的貨物送過去。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But he's a little forgetful, so give it to one of his students. Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3012685^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
不過，他有點健忘，就交給他的學生吧。
記住，箱子的序列號是^3355FF3012685^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But he's a little forgetful, give it to one of his students. Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3487372^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
不過，他有點健忘，就交給他的學生吧。
記住，箱子的序列號是^3355FF3487372^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3318702^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3543625^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Aaaannnnd...
Don't forget to deliver that message for me~
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
還~~有...
別忘了替我帶訊息哦~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't forget your destination and the package's Serial Number.
You'll need to tell them
to the storekeeper.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
別忘了送貨地點和箱子的序列號。
領貨時，你得把這些告訴倉庫管理員。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The storehouse is in the room
to my right. There, you can talk
to the storekeeper, and he'll
help you out.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
倉庫就在我右邊的房間裡。
找倉庫管理員談談，他會幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
After you make the delivery, return to the storehouse and give the receipt to the storekeeper.
Then, come back
and see me.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
送完貨，回倉庫把收據交給倉庫管理員。
然後，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Is that clear?
Alright, that's
the spirit.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
明白了嗎？
好，就是這股幹勁。
路上小心！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
So, what brings you to
the Merchant Association?
Is there anything
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
什麼風把你吹到商人協會來了？
有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to be a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成為商人

scripts.text: Tell me about Merchants.
scripts.translation: 介紹一下商人

scripts.text: Tell me the requirements.
scripts.translation: 告訴我轉職條件

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 沒事

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Do you want to
be a Merchant?
Well...
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
你想成為商人？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, you have to be a Novice with Job Level 10. Once you do that, make sure you learn all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
首先，你必須是職業等級達到10級的初心者，還要學會所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
We're not just
simple money makers!
We pride ourselves on having standards and only accepting qualified applicants!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我們可不只是會賺錢！
我們有自己的標準，只接受合格的申請者，這可是我們的驕傲！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright, you'll need to fill out this application and prepare 1,000 Zeny for your Membership Fee.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
好，你需要填好這份申請表，並準備1,000 Zeny作為會費。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Oh...!
If you don't have all the money,
I can just take 500 Zeny now.
You can pay the rest after you
pass the test and earn your
Merchant Guild License.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
哦...！
錢沒帶夠的話，也可以先交500 Zeny。
通過考試、取得商人公會執照後，再把餘款補齊。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
So what do you think?
Are you ready to join now?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
怎麼樣？
準備好現在加入了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意

scripts.text: Ummm, maybe later...
scripts.translation: 嗯，也許以後吧...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Let me check if you
filled out everything
on your application form...
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
讓我看看你的申請表是不是都填好了...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmm... 
{0}...
That's a nice name.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
嗯...
{0}...
這個名字不錯。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
This application will
only be registered once
the Membership Fee is paid.
How do you wish to
handle the fee?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
繳納會費後，申請才會正式登記。
你打算怎麼付？

scripts.text: Pay all 1,000 Zeny now!
scripts.translation: 現在一次性支付1,000 Zeny！

scripts.text: Two payments of 500 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 分兩次支付，每次500 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
It seems don't have enough zeny to pay all of the fee right now. Why don't you just pay 500 zeny now? Think about it.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
看來，你現在的Zeny不夠一次付清會費。
不如先付500 Zeny？
考慮一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright~
That's 1,000 zeny.
Excellent, excellent.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
好~1,000 Zeny收到了。
很好，很好。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmm...
It seems you don't have the funds to pay half of the membership fee. Please come back once you collect the zeny that you need.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
嗯...
看來，你連一半的會費也付不起。
攢夠所需的Zeny後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Let's see...
That's 500 Zeny. Although I don't think splitting payment is a good idea for any Merchant, it's alright since you're still learning.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
讓我看看...
500 Zeny收到了。
雖然我覺得，商人分期付款可不是什麼好習慣，不過你還在學習，就算了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Feel free to return anytime
when you are ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
等你準備好了，隨時歡迎回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
You don't have enough zeny now? That's no problem. Take your time and come back when you're
ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
現在Zeny不夠？
沒關係，慢慢來，準備好了再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright, you're now on the list of applicants. Ah, before I get started let me say just one thing.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
好，你已經在申請人名單上了。
啊，開始之前，我還有句話要說。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
There are some dumb and greedy people out there who do not know what it means to be a Merchant.
I hope you won't turn out to be like them, will you?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
有些人又蠢又貪，根本不懂商人的意義。
我希望你不會變成那樣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Now, let me
explain what you
need to do for the
Merchant License Test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
現在，我來說明商人執照考試要做些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, then go to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再前往普隆德拉的劍士協會舊址。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then go to the Mage Guild in Geffen. When you get there, visit the Mage Guildsman in charge.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再前往吉芬的魔法師公會。
到了那裡，找負責此事的魔法師公會成員。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then go to Morocc. There you must find Java Dullihan, the dyemaker.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再前往夢羅克，找到染料師爪哇·杜利漢。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then give it to the Kafra Employee stationed on Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
先去倉庫領取送貨用箱子，再交給駐守拜蘭島的卡普拉職員。

scripts.text: [Chief Mahnsoo]
scripts.translation: [首領 曼蘇]

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, visit the Kafra Employee stationed there. Her name is Blossom. Did you get
all of that?
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
到了那裡，找駐守當地的卡普拉職員。
她叫布洛森。
都記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
He's a bit forgetful, so you should probably give the package to one of his students.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
他有點健忘，所以最好把箱子交給他的學生。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ummmm...
And I also have
a bit of a personal
request for you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
嗯...
另外，我還有個私人的小請求。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Would you please give her this message when you deliver the package? Please~
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
送箱子的時候，能替我把這條訊息也帶給她嗎？
拜託啦~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't forget your destination and the package's Serial Number. You will need to tell those to the storekeeper in the storehouse to the right of me.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
別忘了送貨地點和箱子的序列號。
領貨時，你得把這些告訴我右邊倉庫裡的管理員。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
After the delivery, give the receipt to the storekeeper, and then come back and see me.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
送完貨，把收據交給倉庫管理員，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Is that clear?
Alright, that's
the spirit.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
明白了嗎？
好，就是這股幹勁。
路上小心！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Merchant?
Well, we basically sell goods to make money. That is the way
of the Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
商人？
嗯，簡單說，我們就是靠賣貨賺錢。
這就是商人的生存之道。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess we may not be the best at fighting, and we don't have many special attacks. We've got no healing skills...
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我們或許不太擅長戰鬥，也沒多少特殊的攻擊招式，更沒有治療技能...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But we can buy goods at lower prices from NPC shops and sell them at a higher price to other people~
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
但是我們可以從NPC商店低價買入貨物，然後高價賣給其他人~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Our ultimate attack skill is 'Mammonite.' The strength of Mammonite comes from the anger
when we're forced to throw away perfectly good zeny.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
我們最強的攻擊技能是“金錢攻擊”。
這招的威力，來自被迫扔掉辛苦賺來的Zeny時，那股心頭的怒火。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Throwing away zeny like that
causes a deadly rage to well up in the heart of any Merchant!
Just thinking about it
makes my blood boil!
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
就這麼扔掉Zeny，哪個商人心裡不會怒火翻騰！
光是想想，我就氣得血都要沸騰了！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Anyway, we can use most
weapons except Bows, Rods, and Two-Handed Swords. But we can always sell those.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
總之，除了弓、魔杖和雙手劍，大多數武器我們都能使用。
不過，用不了的武器，我們也可以賣嘛。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Yes...
We Merchants generally
have money on our minds...
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
沒錯...
我們商人啊，腦子裡想的通常都是錢...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
There are three conditions that must be fulfilled before you can become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
要成為商人，必須滿足三個條件。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, You have to be a Novice with Job Level 10, and have learned all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
第一，你必須是職業等級達到10級的初心者，並學會所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Second, You have to pay a 1,000 Zeny Membership Fee. I believe any Merchant candidate should be able to earn 1,000 Zeny with ease.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
第二，繳納1,000 Zeny的會費。
我相信，想成為商人的人，賺這1,000 Zeny應該輕而易舉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Third, there is a License Test to test your physical strength and sense of direction. You will deliver a package to a specific person in a specific location.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
第三，通過考驗體力和方向感的執照考試。
你需要把箱子送到指定地點，交給指定的人。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember...
The package's
Serial Number is
^3355FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
記住...
箱子的序列號是^3355FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember...
The package's
Serial Number is
^3355FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 曼蘇]
記住...
箱子的序列號是^3355FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Heya pal.
How ya doin'?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嘿，夥計。
最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey you. We don't have any open positions for part time work. If you wanna earn some zeny, you'll hafta look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嘿，我們這兒沒有兼職空缺。
想賺Zeny的話，得去別處找找。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey you. Yeah, you.
If you wanna restart the test, go visit Mahnsoo in the other room. Then we can talk.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嘿，你，對，就是你。
想重新考試，就去另一個房間找曼蘇。
辦完了，我們再談。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright! Everything looks perfect! I'll report your success to the guildmaster. Now go talk to Chief Mahnsoo, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
好！
一切都沒問題，我會向公會會長報告你通過了考試。
現在去找曼蘇首領吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Oh, yeah? Okay, lemme check. Your name is {0}? Alright, your destination was...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
哦，好，讓我查查。
你叫{0}？
嗯，你的送貨地點是...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Wow! You met the Kafra babe in Prontera?! Lucky you~ ...Receipt?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
哇！
你見到普隆德拉那位卡普拉美女了？！
真走運啊~
...收據呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Geffen Magic Academy. Okay, receipt?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
吉芬魔法學院。
好，收據呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
The dyemaker in Morocc. Not bad. Receipt?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
夢羅克的染料師。
不錯，收據呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Oh hohohoho~! The Kafra Babe on Byalan Island?! Awesome! Anyway, did you bring the receipt?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
哦呵呵呵呵~！
拜蘭島的卡普拉美女？！
太棒了！
對了，收據帶回來了嗎？

scripts.text: [Union Staff Kay]
scripts.translation: [聯盟職員 凱]

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Wait a sec.
Where's the receipt?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
等等，收據呢？
怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
If you don't have the receipt, you fail the test! You better talk to Mahnsoo if you wanna retake it, alright? Pay attention next time!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
沒有收據，就算考試失敗！
想重考就去找曼蘇，好嗎？
下次可得留心！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
...Great! Everything's perfect! I'll report your success to the Guildmaster. You should talk to Chief Mahnsoo now, alright?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
...太好了！
一切都沒問題，我會向公會會長報告你通過了考試。
現在去找曼蘇首領吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Huh?
You're back?
So how did
the delivery go?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
咦，你回來了？
貨送得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: *Sob* I lost the package.
scripts.translation: *抽泣*我把箱子弄丟了

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 很順利

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you kidding me? You'll fail the test if you lose the package!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
你開玩笑吧？
箱子弄丟了，考試就失敗了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Awwww man. Well, if you wanna restart the test, talk to Mahnsoo, okay? You're lucky you're getting another chance!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
哎呀，真是的。
想重新考試就去找曼蘇，好嗎？
還能再給你一次機會，算你走運！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh...
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey, what are you still doing here? Shouldn't you be on your way already?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嘿，你怎麼還在這裡？你不該已經出發了嗎？

scripts.text: I need a new package.
scripts.translation: 我需要一個新箱子

scripts.text: Oh, yeah. You're right!
scripts.translation: 哦，對。你說得對！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Wha--?
So where did
the package go?
Where is it?!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
什...什麼？
箱子去哪兒了？
在哪兒？！

scripts.text: *Sob* I lost it!
scripts.translation: *抽泣*我弄丟了！

scripts.text: I have it right here.
scripts.translation: 就在我這裡

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
You...
Lost it?!
You failed the test!
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
你...弄丟了？！
考試失敗！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
*Sigh* If you want to restart the test, go visit Mahnsoo in the other room, alright?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
*嘆氣*想重考的話，就去另一個房間找曼蘇，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh.
I thought
you lost it.
You don't
need a new one.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
啊，我還以為你弄丟了呢。
既然還在，就不需要新的了。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
*Sigh* Man, you're starting to become a pain in the ass. Hold on, lemme cancel your record...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
*嘆氣*真是的，你可真夠麻煩的。
等一下，我把你的記錄取消...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
I need some time to get everything in order, so come back later.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
我得花點時間整理，晚些再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
What a bummer...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
真掃興...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey there.
what brings
you here?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嘿，找我什麼事？

scripts.text: My Merchant License test.
scripts.translation: 我來參加商人執照考試

scripts.text: I'm looking for part time work.
scripts.translation: 我想找份兼職

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒事

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
I see.
Alright.
So what's
your name?
{0}...?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
明白了。
你叫什麼名字？
{0}...？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh. Your name's not on my list. Did you apply for the job change quest or what?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
咦，名單上沒有你的名字。
你到底有沒有申請轉職？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
You gotta apply first by talking to Chief Mahnsoo in the center
of this building, okay?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
你得先找這棟樓中央的曼蘇首領申請，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright, there you go. Lemme give you the package. Now, choose the destination of the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
好，我把箱子給你。
先選一下送貨地點。

scripts.text: Prontera.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen.
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克

scripts.text: Byalan Island.
scripts.translation: 拜蘭島

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Okay, now you need to give me the package's Serial Number. If you wanna cancel, just enter '0', alright?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
好，現在告訴我箱子的序列號。
想取消的話，就輸入“0”，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you sure that you wanna cancel?
Alright, we'll cancel for now.
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
確定要取消？
好，那就先取消吧。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you sure that you wanna cancel?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
你確定要取消嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Let me try again.
scripts.translation: 讓我再試一次

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey hey. That number's not valid! Enter a value from 1000000 to 5000000. got it?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
嘿，這個號碼無效！
請輸入1000000到5000000之間的數值，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Prontera. The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
送貨地點是普隆德拉，序列號是{0}。
確定沒錯？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Geffen. Phew! That's really far! The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
送貨地點是吉芬。
呼，真夠遠的！
序列號是{0}，確定沒錯？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Morocc. That's pretty far away! The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
送貨地點是夢羅克，挺遠的啊！
序列號是{0}，確定沒錯？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Lucky you! Your destination is Byalan Island. The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
你真走運！
送貨地點是拜蘭島，序列號是{0}。
確定沒錯？

scripts.text: Positive.
scripts.translation: 確定

scripts.text: Whoops! Wrong number!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！號碼錯了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright. Take this package and guard it with your life until it's safely delivered to the customer. Don't lose this thing, got it?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
好，拿著這個箱子，拼了命也得護好，直到安全送到客戶手裡。
別弄丟了，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Well then, I wish you luck. Remember, you gotta bring me
a receipt once you finish the delivery, okay?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
祝你好運。
記住，送完貨一定要把收據帶回來給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Part time job? Sorry pal, no jobs yet. The Paymaster's department can never balance our budget...
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
兼職？
抱歉，夥計，目前沒有空缺。
財務部門連預算都平衡不了...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Nothing, eh?
I guess you enjoy
bothering people for
no reason then, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[聯盟職員 凱]
沒事？
那你就是喜歡沒事打擾別人嘍？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
You're from
the Merchant Guild?
Yes! You've come to
the right place.
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
您是商人公會派來的？
沒錯，您來對地方了！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
But...
Where's the
package I ordered?
That's strange...
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
可是...
我訂的箱子呢？
真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Okay~
Please set the
package down
over there.
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
好~請把箱子放在那邊。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Let me check the Serial Number of the package so I can give you the receipt, okay?
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
我先核對一下箱子的序列號，再給您收據，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3012685. See?
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
抱歉，不過...
這好像不是我們訂的箱子。
序列號應該是3012685，您看？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3487372. See?
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
抱歉，不過...
這好像不是我們訂的箱子。
序列號應該是3487372，您看？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3012685 or 3487372. Well, one of those two...
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
抱歉，不過...
這好像不是我們訂的箱子。
序列號應該是3012685或3487372。
嗯，這兩個號碼中的一個...

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
3012685...
That's right.
Here's your
receipt.
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
3012685...
沒錯，這是您的收據。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
3487372...
That's right.
Here's your
receipt.
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
3487372...
沒錯，這是您的收據。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Thanks a lot!
See you again
sometime!
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
非常感謝！
有機會再見！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Oh...
You're gonna
go back? Okay
then, take care!
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
哦，您要回去了？
那好，路上小心！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Mr. Java Dullihan is the one and only, the best dye maker on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
爪哇·杜利漢先生是米德加爾特大陸上獨一無二、最出色的染料師。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Aaaand I'm proud to say that I'm his student! Someday, I'll be able to make really beautiful dyes too!
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
而~~且，我可是他的學生，真是太自豪了！
總有一天，我也能做出非常漂亮的染料！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Of course, I'm still learning the basics right now, but someday...
scripts.translation:
[染料師的學徒]
當然，現在我還在學基礎，不過，總有一天...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Ah, you must be with the Merchant Guild. Finally, my package has arrived! Alright...!
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
啊，您是商人公會派來的吧。
我的箱子終於到了！
太好了...！

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Wait...
Where's the
package?
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
等等...
箱子呢？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
You must be very tired
from having to travel
in this kind
of weather...
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
這種天氣還要趕路，您一定累壞了...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
Uh oh, this is the wrong number. This isn't what we ordered...
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
好，讓我核對一下序列號...
哎呀，號碼不對，這不是我們訂的貨...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
2989396. Yes, this is what we ordered. Here is your receipt.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
好，讓我核對一下序列號...
2989396，沒錯，這是我們訂的貨。
這是您的收據。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
2191737. Yes, this is what we ordered. Here is your receipt.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
好，讓我核對一下序列號...
2191737，沒錯，這是我們訂的貨。
這是您的收據。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2989396.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
序列號應該是2989396。
您看！
沒發現哪裡不對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2191737.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
序列號應該是2191737。
您看！
沒發現哪裡不對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2989396
or 2191737, one of
those two.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
序列號應該是2989396或2191737，這兩個號碼中的一個。
您看！
沒發現哪裡不對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Heh heh~
Thank you!
Bye bye!
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
呵呵~
謝謝！
再見！

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Hello,
Merchant Guildsman~
I give you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
你好，商人公會的朋友~
真是謝謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
My package should have arrived by now. Huh. I guess the Merchant Guild might be running a little late...
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
我的箱子該到了吧。
嗯，看來商人公會有點耽擱了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh! Thank you for
traveling such a long
